categories.main_business_segments: Brite Semiconductor (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. focuses on providing one-stop chip customization services, including chip design and chip mass production services. The company offers full-custom chip design and engineering-custom chip design services, serving industries such as IoT, industrial control, consumer electronics, network communication, smart cities, and automotive electronics.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages large-scale SoC customization design technology and semiconductor IP development technology as its core technical systems. It has capabilities in advanced logic process design, high-performance analog IP, and high-speed interface IP development, including DDR, Serdes, PCIe, MIPI, USB, PSRAM, and EMMC IPs. The company employs a fabless model, outsourcing wafer manufacturing and packaging/testing to third-party foundries and subcontractors.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include system manufacturers and chip design companies. The company's chip products are widely applied in IoT, industrial control, consumer electronics, network communication, smart cities, and automotive electronics sectors. The top five customers accounted for 42.57% of sales in 2024, indicating a diversified customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and main operations in Shanghai Free Trade Zone. It has subsidiaries and business presence in Hong Kong, the United States, Singapore, and other regions. Approximately 20.76% of revenue in 2024 came from overseas sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Brite Semiconductor operates as a fabless semiconductor design service provider, positioned upstream in the semiconductor supply chain focusing on chip design and customization. It outsources wafer fabrication and packaging/testing to foundries like SMIC and packaging firms such as Hua Tian Technology.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D investment, focusing on advanced SoC design platforms, high-performance semiconductor IPs, and emerging technology areas such as ISP, automotive-grade MCUs, Wi-Fi+BLE combo chips, and ADCs. It emphasizes innovation in chip design efficiency, low power consumption, and integration of AI capabilities. R&D expenses accounted for 11.73% of revenue in 2024, reflecting increased commitment to technology development.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through providing one-stop chip customization services, including chip design services and subsequent chip mass production services. The company does not sell chips under its own brand but earns income by serving system manufacturers and chip design companies with customized chip solutions.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Brite Semiconductor is a leading global player in the integrated circuit design service industry, recognized as a top-tier chip design service provider. It maintains strategic partnerships with leading foundries like SMIC and competes with other fabless design service companies and semiconductor IP providers in China and globally.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenue of approximately RMB 1.09 billion, a decrease of 18.77% compared to 2023. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 61 million, down 64.19%. Despite revenue decline, net assets grew by 66.63% to RMB 1.37 billion, driven by IPO proceeds and retained earnings. The company has 342 employees, with 155 in R&D, and continues to invest heavily in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Brite Semiconductor offers high-value, differentiated one-stop chip customization services with a comprehensive technology platform covering advanced process nodes and diverse application scenarios. Its competitive advantages include high design efficiency, high first-pass success rate, extensive IP portfolio, and strong collaboration with leading foundries. The company emphasizes low cost, low risk, and fast time-to-market for customers, enabling tailored chip solutions across multiple industries.
